scope: Reviewed incremental tile scale/stock, limestone registration and valance emission repair. Not photoreal, human, four-region, gameplay or V2 completion acceptance. Explicit unresolved glazing highlight, warm cast and period signage debt remain.

images.observation: Loaded tiled party wall seen through the shop glazing now has coherent small running-bond courses rather than baked cracks; the lower-emission fascia retains a surface. White glazing oval and warm cast remain open.
Carried light illuminates individual shed boards and fitted post/beam framing. The tile scale remains consistent; glazing highlight still clips white.
Overhead decking, secondary joists and supported beams remain distinct and opaque. No native shed geometry changed in this finish pass.
Carried light shows timber direction, separate board edges and fasteners; warm production lighting remains dominant.
Separate original closure lettering remains readable on paper; seated diagonal brace and fasteners remain visible.
Closer carried-light view retains blank paper stock beneath separate lettering, board grain, joints and bolt heads.
Post/beam joint retains seated solids, end grain and bolt hardware; no new gaps through native stock.
Grazing carried light retains grain direction and bolt hardware on the unchanged native joint.
Actual production view: corrected tile courses behind the right store glass; valance retains soft transmitted illumination and texture. White oval remains an unacceptable glazing highlight.
Disposable selected-material normal-off control keeps the same regular tile courses. The former cracks were baked albedo, not simply exaggerated normal strength.
Disposable emission-off control reveals valance surface colour. Normal production emission is restored after this control.
Disposable right-pane-hidden control removes the clipped white oval while retaining tile and practical lamp, isolating the remaining defect to glazing. Production pane visibility is restored.
Front view retains original independent red lettering and softly lit fascia. Construction post partially occludes the sign; original bright projecting cabinet and period material/wording remain open.
Same front camera with only valance emission disabled: face darkens while original cabinet and practical lamp remain lit, confirming their distinct material authorities.
